title: Listening to the Voices: Describing Ethical Caveats of Conversational User Interfaces According to Experts and Frequent Users

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews with CUI researchers, practitioners, and frequent users, identifying the marginalization of users with strong accents, colloquial dialects, and non-native languages.

Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews, highlighting accessibility barriers and systemic exclusion of individuals with speech or cognitive deficits, visual and physical disabilities, and autism.
Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews, revealing the vulnerability and 'othering' of users with lower technological or digital literacy.
